title: What is MCP?

body.text: that lets AI connect to external tools and data. Think of it as the AI's 'USB port': plug in any tool and the AI can use it, without building a custom one-off connection every time.

example: Connect MCP so the AI can read files in your project folder, then ask 'summarize what this code does'

title: What problem does it solve?

body.text: Normally AI only knows what we type. MCP lets the AI
— files, databases, calendars, or company systems — in a structured, secure way, so answers are grounded in real data instead of guesses.

example: Connect MCP to a sales database → ask 'what are the top 5 best-selling products this month?'
